title: Ex-OpenAI Engineer Detained in Spy Device Case
excerpt: A former OpenAI engineer accused of planting a recording device at the San Francisco office has been ordered detained by a U.S. court.
body_html:
A U.S. court has granted a government request to detain a former OpenAI engineer facing accusations of placing a recording device inside an executive conference room at the company's office in San Francisco. According to prosecutors, the objective was to allegedly steal sensitive secrets.

In a court filing submitted on Sunday, prosecutors detailed that the 35-year-old former employee, Abdulrahman Alfozan, maintained frequent communications through WhatsApp.
